activity_summary: You walked fast, head down, and said Navarre's first line until it sat in the breath. An archer told you to mind the butt. You stayed on the path. You did not open the rest of the speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the line three times and took it with him.

facets.activity: Said Navarre's first line until it sat in the breath

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Let Fame, that all hunt after in their lyues.
